retrieved_synopses: In this dialogue, you have killed Nere without doing the duergar mutineers quest. As a result, they want you to pay for the trouble you've caused. You can give them money, persuade them to let you live, or attack.

You’ve already killed Nere but never completed the duergar mutineers quest, so the duergar treat his death as your crime and demand compensation for the trouble you caused. Elder Brithvar and his clan are on site, tense and ready to leave Moonrise Towers with prisoners and loot — they explicitly claim any gnome slaves as “clan property.” Companions (Karlach appears in the scene; others like Gale might speak up) can argue for the captives or push toward violence. Off‑screen, Nere’s corpse and the captured gnomes/servants (possibly including the elevator gnome Skickpit or other enslaved folk) are present as leverage, and reinforcements or further duergar reprisals could arrive if you refuse to pay or try to bargain. Your immediate choices are to pay them, persuade/intimidate them into letting you live and freeing the captives, or fight.

Dialogue after you destroy the cave-in and set Nere free. Thrinn has been put in charge of getting Nere out, but it's the player who accomplishes it. Nere almost just died from inhaling poisonous gas, so he's very angry. In this dialogue, you determine the fate of the gnomes as well as Nere and the mutinous duergar.

Pissed off duergar raider who is standing guard while the gnomes are digging up a collapsed tunnel. He is cursing his superior, saying they should just let him suffocate. The player can make use of this and threathen the duergar, saying they will tell the sergeant unless the duergar gives them money.

After fighting and killing a group of duergar servants that mutinied against him, Nere takes his rage and frustration out on one of their bodies by kicking it. Once he's done, he takes the players to a nearby broken bridge and explains that he needs reinforcements. The player can promise they'll inform his boss - Chosen Ketheric - or not.
context: You killed Nere but never completed the duergar mutineers quest, so Elder Brithvar and his rebel duergar treat Nere’s death as your crime and demand compensation. Off‑screen Nere’s corpse and a number of bound gnomes/servants (used as clan property and leverage) are present, and Brithvar’s clan is tense and ready to leave Moonrise Towers with prisoners and loot. Companions such as Karlach — and possibly Gale — are on scene and may argue for the captives or push toward violence. Your immediate options in the exchange are to hand over money, try to persuade or intimidate them into letting you (and/or the gnomes) go, or fight, with the risk of duergar reprisals or reinforcements.
